allot.text: EFC (I) Limited has informed the Exchange that Board of Directors at its meeting held on May 25, 2026, has approved allotment of equity shares on rights basis.

allot.subject: Updates
allot.text: EFC (I) Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'Letter of Offer for the Rights Issue'.

allot.subject: Record Date
allot.text: EFC (I) Limited has informed the Exchange that Record date for the purpose of Rights Issue  is 07-May-2026.

allot.subject: Rights Issue
allot.text: The Board of Directors has approved the issuance of 1,06,62,786 Rights Equity on Issue price of Rs. 150 for an amount aggregating to Rs. 159,94,17,900

allot.subject: Rights Issue
allot.text: EFC (I) Limited has informed the Exchange that Board of Directors at its meeting held on May 01, 2026, has decided to issue 1,06,62,786 equity shares on rights basis in the ratio of 8 : 103, i.e 8 Equity Shares for every 103 Equity Shares held. Issue Price is Rs. 150 per share.

allot.subject: Rights Issue
allot.text: EFC (I) Limited has informed the Exchange that Board of Directors at its meeting held on April 3, 2026, has considered and approved  the issuance of fully paid-up equity shares of the Company of face value of Rs. 2 each for an amount not exceeding Rs. 160 crore  by way of a rights issue.
